conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to broad indices and quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth with risk management.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4% per month. It uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs can decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential large losses.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It rotates into income ETFs and broad index, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, remember distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
